parameters.name: exportTaskId
parameters.description: The ID of the resource export task.

parameters.name: keyword
parameters.description: The search keyword. Fuzzy match is supported for export version names.

parameters.name: pageSize
parameters.description: The number of results per page. Default value: 20. Minimum value: 1. Maximum value: 100.

parameters.name: status
parameters.description:
The export status. Valid values:

- Queue: queued
- Pending: preparing to run
- Success: succeeded
- Errored: failed
- Canceled: canceled.
